briefing.headline: Harbour lead 2-0 at the break with 77.7% of the final-third passing

working.text: Harbour are controlling possession and territory (possession 57% and field tilt 77.7%).
Harbour are creating substantially more chances (xG 2.6) and have taken many more shots (14) with more on target (8).

not_working.text: Half of Harbour's final-third entries come through the centre (channel share centre 50%), concentrating their attack centrally.
Their press intensity may be fragile relative to game flow (wmean PPDA 6.6 is higher than the first-half PPDA 4.6), suggesting variability in pressing intensity.

predictions.claim: Harbour will shift more of their final-third entries to the right so right-channel entries increase by at least 40%.
Harbour's PPDA will rise by at least 20% as pressing intensity eases.
Harbour will try to reduce Kestrel's central overload, cutting Kestrel centre entries by at least 30%.

working.text: Kestrel still favour central entries when they attack (centre channel share 55.6%).
They retain a measurable share of possession (43%) and have made a reasonable number of progressive passes (72).

not_working.text: Kestrel are being overrun in territory and high ball wins: field tilt 22.3% and zero high regains.
Their press is light (PPDA 11.5) and they win the ball much lower (turnover height 19.2 m).
Kestrel have created fewer chances (xG 0.82) and registered fewer shots (6) with only one on target.

predictions.claim: Kestrel will drop a midfielder to sit deeper so Harbour's high regains drop by at least 30%.
Kestrel will try to win more possession, increasing their possession by at least 10 percentage points.
Kestrel will crowd the centre to cut Harbour's central entries by at least 30%.
